name: Punchy talking head (Hormozi-style)
description: Vertical talking head with every pause and filler cut out, a bold hook line in the first second and a single call to action at the end. Word-by-word captions and punch-in zooms, which define this look, are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

variables.name: title
variables.label: Hook line
variables.example: You are editing your videos wrong

platforms.note: Shorts can run up to 3 minutes

beats.name: Hook
beats.guidance: Open on the claim or the promise. No intro, no logo, no breath before the first word.

beats.name: The point
beats.guidance: One idea only. A fresh angle or a tighter frame every 1 to 3 seconds keeps it moving.

beats.name: One ask
beats.guidance: Ask for one thing: follow, comment or click.

deferred.title: Word-by-word captions
deferred.description: Two to four words on screen at a time, bold uppercase, the spoken word highlighted with a dark outline, lower third, each word popping in.

deferred.title: Punch-in zooms
deferred.description: Alternate a wide and a 10 to 20 percent tighter frame at each jump cut.

deferred.title: Speaker fills the frame
deferred.description: Re-frame the speaker to fill at least 60 percent of the vertical frame.

deferred.title: Quiet music bed
deferred.description: Subtle low-energy music under the voice, with no transition sound effects.

deferred.title: Contrasty colour
deferred.description: Higher contrast, warm skin tones and a near-black background.

notes.text: Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Claims about results, savings, speed or income need evidence you can show. Avoid guarantees, and say 'results vary' next to any result you show.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.

confirmations.ask: Does the hook line match what the video really delivers?
